question: When does desire for Shiva-God arise in beasts per Nandisikha?
premises: said in Nandisikha-tantra, in eastern six, by Maheshin
desire in Shiva, in God, of beasts arises then
inference: Eastern-six Maheshin word: beast-desire for Shiva arises.
plain_english: Said in Nandisikha-tantra, in eastern six, by Maheshin — desire in Shiva, in God, of beasts arises then.
